title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Coastal Concentration Load in Renewal Rating
content:
**Coastal concentration load (Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, residential renewal schedule, Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier).** The program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by 1.10 when 3 or more certificates on buildings in flood zone V or VE were issued under the program in the last 36 months, by 1.05 when 1 or 2 were, and by 1.00 when none was.

- The flood zone is the zone on each certificate's issue entry; zones V and VE are the coastal high hazard zones.
- The count runs over the program's issue entries, on any loan, processed within the window: a renewal window of the last 36 months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 36 whole calendar months have passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Certificates in zone V or VE issued in the last 36 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| None | 1.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 1.05 |
| 3 or more | 1.10 |

*Points of judgement.* A certificate in zone AE or AO is not counted. Two zone VE certificates and one zone V certificate in the window make 3, and the multiplier is 1.10.
